races.paceDynamic: Inishbeg will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Simba's Pride, Advance Twentyfive, Zarvali and Fozzie providing prominent support but none aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. The pace will be controlled and sustainable over this 7f trip, with the bulk of the field (including Deep Sleep, Weffaag, Forest Phoenix, Haltonwood and Saxon Gem) content to sit back and wait. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick, as they'll get first run on a large group of hold-up horses who'll face a traffic-heavy finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Inishbeg sets an uncontested lead with the prominent group tracking smoothly
scenarios.body: The pace-trackers get first run while the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic behind a wall of horses. Advance Twentyfive and Zarvali are perfectly positioned to strike with their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Inishbeg's sustainable gallop proves too strong for this modest maiden field
scenarios.body: The Kevin Ryan-trained gelding gets an easy lead and has enough in hand to resist the late challenges. His recent placed efforts suggest he's ready to break his maiden.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: Deep Sleep or Weffaag benefit from a crawling gallop that plays to their closing style. The Haggas-trained Weffaag has the class edge despite his fade tendency.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to fire and traffic chaos strikes the principals
scenarios.body: One of the unconsidered runners like Talking In Kode or Forest Phoenix sneaks through on the rails while the market leaders are stuck. The 5lb claim helps Talking In Kode's cause.

watchPoints.text: Advance Twentyfive returning from 190-day absence could need the run despite retaining highest official rating
Inishbeg's prominent style could be compromised if any of the other forward runners decide to press early

Weffaag's tendency to fade in finish could be crucial if he gets into winning position approaching final furlong

races.paceDynamic: Iris Dancer is the only confirmed front runner and will likely get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners (Lord Abama, Mr Dreamseller, Yes I'm Mali, Ay Gee Ell) settling just behind rather than challenging early. This creates a sustainable pace scenario where the leader won't be put under pressure through the early stages. With 13 of the 18 runners preferring hold-up tactics, there will be significant traffic problems in the closing stages as they all try to make their moves simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours the early-positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable congestion, particularly those who can track Iris Dancer and prominent runners like Mr Dreamseller and Lord Abama.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Iris Dancer gets an easy lead with the prominent pack settling kindly behind
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front division to control the race and kick clear when the hold-up horses get into trouble. Early-positioned runners like Mr Dreamseller and Ay Gee Ell can capitalise on their tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the 13 hold-up horses create a wall of traffic in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The sheer weight of numbers trying to make ground simultaneously creates a bottleneck that prevents the better horses from delivering their finishing kicks. Those who get clear runs by tracking the early pace benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Iris Dancer Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran leader maintains her gallop and the field fails to organise a serious challenge
scenarios.body: Her recent second at Southwell suggests she's returning to form and with no serious early pressure she can dictate terms throughout. The hold-up brigade leaves their moves too late to catch her.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find racing room and the early pace collapses
scenarios.body: A few of the better hold-up performers manage to weave through traffic and pick up the pieces as the front-runners tire. This requires significant luck in running given the field composition.

races.paceDynamic: Beaujolais Nouveau will take them along from the front with City Captain and Draupnir likely to sit prominent, but this field is overwhelmingly comprised of hold-up horses who prefer to come from behind. With only one confirmed front runner, Beaujolais Nouveau can dictate a steady gallop without early pressure, allowing the race to develop into a typical sprint finish scenario. The lack of early pace pressure means the tempo will be measured early before quickening significantly in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will affect the massed ranks of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Beaujolais Nouveau gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady early gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to conserve energy for a strong finish, while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind. The prominent racers like City Captain can track the leader and benefit from the clean run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field bunches up approaching the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the classier hold-up horses to unleash devastating late kicks despite traffic concerns. Strong finishers with tactical speed can weave through and time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Beaujolais Nouveau sets steady fractions but begins to tire inside the final furlong
scenarios.body: City Captain or another prominent runner can sit in the perfect stalking position and pounce when the leader weakens. They avoid both the early pace battle and the late traffic issues.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates a cavalry charge finish with severe traffic problems
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial, potentially allowing an outsider with a clear run to sneak through. Form and class take a backseat to racing luck and jockey skill.

City Captain's ability to track Beaujolais Nouveau closely without getting into an early battle

races.paceDynamic: Son and the prominent runners Kosometsuke and It'sneverjustone will set a modest pace early, with no confirmed speed horses to force the issue. The large field of hold-up horses including Narmar, Warm Spell, Brighton Boy, and Mudamer will create a compressed field through the middle sections. This sustainable pace will allow the hold-up brigade to close strongly in the final two furlongs, creating a cavalry charge finish. The race shape heavily favours hold-up horses who can quicken from off the pace in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains modest as expected with Son tracking without pressure
scenarios.body: The compressed field will explode late with multiple closers unleashing finishing kicks simultaneously. Hold-up specialists with proven acceleration will have every chance to strike from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Persists
scenarios.trigger: If Kosometsuke and It'sneverjustone maintain forward positions without excessive early pressure
scenarios.body: They can dictate terms throughout and may have enough in reserve to resist the late charge. Their prominent style gives them first run on the field when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Son fails to maintain any forward momentum leaving a complete lack of early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling tactical affair until an explosive sprint, suiting horses with the most devastating turn of foot. Only the sharpest finishers survive such a scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Son Shows Unexpected Speed
scenarios.trigger: If Son decides to make use of his prominent style and genuinely leads throughout
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger gallop that may stretch the field and blunt some finishing kicks. Horses that can travel strongly in behind benefit from the honest pace.

watchPoints.text: Son and Kosometsuke must show early intent to establish any meaningful pace, otherwise this becomes a sprint finish

races.paceDynamic: Don Simon will likely lead uncontested from the gates, with Idyllic the only other prominent runner likely to track close behind. This creates a sustainable pace scenario with minimal early pressure, allowing the leaders to dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The large field of hold-up horses (Nightsinwhitesatin, Lightning Tiger, Helmsley, Minhad, Hackney Diamonds) will be content to settle behind and rely on finishing kicks over this 1m4f trip. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and capitalise on the modest early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Don Simon gets an easy lead with soft fractions.
scenarios.body: Don Simon faces minimal early pressure and kicks clear turning for home, while the hold-up brigade struggle to make up significant ground from their patient positions. The pace proves too modest for closers to unleash devastating finishes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and bunches the field.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a sprint finish where the classier hold-up horses can utilise their turn of foot. Nightsinwhitesatin and Lightning Tiger benefit from the tactical nature and strong finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Troubles Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight.
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get stopped for runs or forced wide, allowing a horse with a clear passage to capitalise. Hackney Diamonds or Made All benefit from being less fancied and finding racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Don Simon fails to lead or goes too fast early.
scenarios.body: Idyllic inherits an ideal position if the expected leader doesn't perform his role, or the fractions become unsustainable. The race sets up perfectly for Hollie Doyle to time her challenge.

watchPoints.text: Don Simon must jump alertly and establish position early - any hesitation allows Idyllic to steal the initiative

races.paceDynamic: Merlier, Simplify, and Hanney Girl will battle for the early lead, with Merlier's recent front-running wins making her the likely pacesetter. Six prominent runners (Daneh Of Dandy, The Lost Sock, Mo Of Cairo, Dazzling Haze, Exclamation, Rikki Tiki Tavi) create serious congestion behind the leaders in a sprint where positioning is crucial. The strong pace from three confirmed front-runners will ensure a true test of stamina over this five furlongs, with the tempo likely unsustainable for all three pace-setters. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can sit just off the pace and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, as the early leaders will tie up in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast and tie up dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop from Merlier, Simplify and Hanney Girl will set up perfectly for Big Fun and Go Vince Go to sweep past tired leaders. Both hold-up horses have the class and finishing speed to capitalize when the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the six prominent runners can secure the ideal position just off the pace without getting trapped
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will stretch the field but not completely stop the leaders, allowing a well-positioned prominent runner to strike. Exclamation or The Lost Sock can use their tactical speed to thread through and win.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Merlier or Simplify can break clear of their pace rivals and dictate terms alone
scenarios.body: Without the pressure of two other front-runners alongside, one leader can control the tempo and maintain enough for victory. Merlier's recent front-running success gives her the best chance of lasting home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Creates Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders completely neutralize each other while the prominent runners get stuck in traffic
scenarios.body: The combination of suicidal pace and traffic problems for the main contenders opens the door for a runner at bigger odds. Schrodinger's Cat or Star Material could benefit from the chaos ahead.

races.paceDynamic: Langholm and Stormy Pearl will lock horns early as the confirmed front-runners, with Run This Way, Hurstwood, and Tommytwohoots also keen to stay handy. This creates a genuine pace test up front with multiple speed horses committed to racing prominently on the sharp Thirsk 6f track. The large field of 17 runners and contested early pace will set up a strong gallop that should suit horses with finishing kicks. Hold-up horses like Piperstown, Wee Mary, and What What What are perfectly positioned to benefit from this aggressive early tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Langholm and Stormy Pearl engage in a speed duel with prominent runners pressing
scenarios.body: The early leaders burn out in the final furlong as the pace takes its toll, creating perfect conditions for closers to sweep past tired front-runners. Hold-up specialists get the ideal setup to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an easier lead than expected
scenarios.body: Langholm or Stormy Pearl manages the early fractions cleverly and has enough left to repel late challenges, with prominent runners filling the placings. The pace is strong enough to help but not destructive enough to stop a smart front-runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong but the hold-up horses fail to deliver
scenarios.body: Mid-pack runners like Golden Prosperity and Hurstwood time their moves perfectly, benefiting from the pace without getting caught up in the early burn. They strike at the ideal moment when leaders tire but before closers arrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Moderate Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the two main pace-setters are unusually conservative early
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical than expected, negating the closer's advantage and allowing stamina to matter more than finishing speed. This unlikely scenario would suit horses with tactical speed and solid staying power.

watchPoints.text: Langholm and Stormy Pearl must be monitored pre-race as both return from breaks exceeding 160 days which creates significant fitness doubts
Piperstown's recent course-and-distance wins make him dangerous if the predicted strong early pace materializes as expected
What What What represents the Easterby stable who excel at Thirsk and his hold-up style perfectly suits the likely race shape
Golden Prosperity's prominent style and current winning form could prove effective if the early pace is more moderate than anticipated
The 5lb claiming jockeys on Wee Mary and Siviez provide crucial weight advantages in this competitive handicap field
